Metadata.title: CrossFit Box · Timer
Metadata.description: Set up the workout on the computer and send it to the phone on the rig.

Home.title: CrossFit Box Timer
Home.tagline: Set up the workout on the computer. The phone on the rig does the rest.
Home.coachLink: I'm a coach: set up workouts
Home.demoLink: Try the timer on your phone

Demos.title: Demo workouts
Demos.intro: Try the timer on this phone without a coach account.
Demos.quick: Quick test: 3 intervals of 20 s to check the beeps.
Demos.fullHour: Endurance test: 60 minutes without touching the phone, with beeps every minute.

Timer.startHint: One tap: turns on sound and keeps the screen awake.
Timer.confirmStopBody: The timer goes back to the start screen.
Timer.confirmRestartBody: It starts again with the prep countdown.
Timer.tapForSound: Tap here to turn the sound back on
Timer.tapForSoundHint: The browser paused the audio. The clock keeps running.
Timer.checkVolume: Turn up the phone volume (or the Bluetooth speaker).
Timer.checkPower: Ideally plugged in, with battery saver off.
Timer.checkControls: During the workout, tap the screen to show the controls.
Timer.installIos: On iPhone, for full screen: Share → Add to Home Screen, then open it from the icon.
Timer.wakeLockUnsupported: This browser can't keep the screen on: turn off auto-lock in the phone settings.
Timer.wakeLockFailed: Couldn't keep the screen on. Turn off battery saver or auto-lock.

Coach.signInBody: Sign in with your CrossFit Box Google account (@yaqbot.com) to set up workouts.
Coach.comingSoon: This is where you will set up workouts and send them to the phone on the rig.
Coach.deniedNotACoach: This account doesn't belong to CrossFit Box. Sign in with your @yaqbot.com account.
Coach.deniedEmailNotVerified: Google hasn't verified this account's email.

Builder.title: New workout
Builder.intro: Pick a mode, set it up and send it to the phone on the rig.
Builder.modeForTimeHint: The work is fixed: as fast as possible, with a time cap.
Builder.modeAmrapHint: The time is fixed: as many rounds as possible.
Builder.modeEmomHint: A block of work at the start of every interval.
Builder.name: Name (optional)
Builder.descriptionPlaceholder: One per line. E.g. 21-15-9, Thrusters, Pull-ups
Builder.preview: How it will look on the phone
Builder.errorForm: Check the fields marked in red.
Builder.errorServer: Couldn't send it. Please try again.
Builder.errorSession: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

errors.intervalRange: Between {min, number} seconds and {max, number} minutes.
errors.totalTooLong: The EMOM can't last more than {max, number} minutes in total.

Share.title: Ready for the phone
Share.otherDeviceHow: Copy the link and send it over, for example on WhatsApp.
Share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy it. Select it and copy it by hand.
Share.orScan: Or scan this QR with the phone's camera.
Share.scanAlt: QR code that opens the workout on the phone
Share.howTitle: What we recommend for each phone
Share.iphoneHow: Open the link in Safari, tap Share → Add to Home Screen and open it from the icon: that's the only way to get full screen. If the app is already installed, open it and type the code {code}.
Share.androidHow: Open the link or scan the QR. Chrome goes full screen when you tap Start.
Share.notFound: This share doesn't exist or has expired.

PhoneHome.title: Timer
PhoneHome.intro: Type the code shown on the coach's screen.
PhoneHome.invalid: The code has 6 characters: letters and numbers.
PhoneHome.notFoundBody: Check the code or ask the coach to send the workout again. Codes expire after 7 days.
PhoneHome.loadFailedBody: Check the phone's connection and try again.
